coordinate_system.primary_axis: Z axis of revolution / central through-bore axis
coordinate_system.orientation_notes: Front view looks along -Z. Section A-A states its horizontal axis is the primary axis of revolution, so Z is the dominant turning/boring axis; radial dimensions lie in X/Y.

features.name: Central Bore
features.description: Central through bore running the entire length of the component.

features.name: Knurl Detail
features.description: V-shaped groove pattern forming a knurl. The note specifies 28 to 32 places equally spaced at both ends of the part.

features.name: Overall Tubular Body
features.description: Overall length of the tubular component, measured across the extreme ends.

features.name: End Flanges
features.description: Flanged sections at both ends of the part, bearing knurling on their outer diameter.

features.name: Main Body OD
features.description: The central cylindrical outer surface between the two end flanges.

features.name: Flange Transition Fillets
features.description: Fillet radii at the junction between the central body OD and the inner faces of the flanges.

features.name: Internal Bore Corner Breaks
features.description: Corner breaks or chamfers at both entry points of the central through bore.

relationships.detail: Central through bore and main body OD share the axis of revolution shown in Section A-A.
Central through bore and the two end flanges are concentric rotational features about the part axis.
Knurl/groove places are equally spaced around the central part axis established by the central through bore.
The knurl detail is specified at both ends and Section A-A identifies the end flange regions as the knurled end surfaces.
Flange transition fillets occur at the junction of the end flanges.
Flange transition fillets occur at the junction between the main body OD and flange inner faces.
Internal bore corner breaks are located at the entry edges of the central through bore.
Corner breaks are secondary edge features dependent on the central through bore entries.
The end flanges are specified as 2X, one at each end along the part axis.
The flange transition fillets are specified as 2X at the two flange transitions along the part axis.

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: No datum definitions or GD&T datum reference frame were extracted from the supplied section graphs.

feature_graph.part_notes: Material: SAE J403 GRADE 1008-1020. Material standard: SAE J403. Scale: 1:1. General tolerance: ASME Y14.5M-1994. Projection: third angle. Heat treatment: none specified. Coating: PHOSPHATE COAT PER PS-119.0. General notes: DEBURR: BREAK ALL SHARP EDGES 0.5 MAX.. FINISH: PHOSPHATE COAT PER PS-119.0. TOLERANCE: METRIC DIMENSIONS & TOLERANCES GOVERN THE DESIGN. ENGLISH DIMENSIONS IF INCLUDED ARE FOR INFORMATION PURPOSES ONLY.. Testing: CRUSH TEST per PS-122.10 (121kN, 60.5kN, 0.38mm). Extraction notes: Revision table column headers are partially cut off but inferred as Revision, Description, Change #, By, Date.

assumptions.text: Grouped front_view:F2 with section_a_a:F4 as the same central bore using the section cut evidence through the center and matching coaxial bore descriptions. section_a_a:F4 was chosen canonical because it explicitly dimensions the bore and proves the THRU condition.

Grouped front_view:F1 with section_b_b:F1 as the same knurled/toothed profile. The B-B section/detail is the only supplied feature in section_b_b and defines the groove geometry and equally spaced places; front_view:F1 contributes the annular diameter limits. section_b_b:F1 was chosen canonical because it is the detail view for the groove/knurl geometry.

Did not group section_a_a:F2 or section_a_a:F3 with the knurl/tooth group because they describe substrate rotational surfaces, not the detailed groove/tooth profile, and grouping them would merge incompatible diameter fields.
Used Z as the part primary axis based on the front-view viewing direction and Section A-A coordinate note. No datum origin was assigned because no datum definitions were extracted.
